name: formulaic_sequence_penalty
reasoning: Champion fails on R2_02-R2_07 (overly elaborate text scoring 1.0). Formulaic sequences are high-frequency conventional co-occurrences. A pure vocabulary-divergence scorer (combinational_novelty) rewards verbose flowery language without constraining formulaicity. This targets the uncovered cliche_formulaicity node: high-frequency bigrams correlate with convention/cliche, should reduce creativity score.

import math
import re
import numpy as np
from wordfreq import word_frequency

_W = re.compile(r'[a-zA-Z\']+')

def _bigrams(text):
    toks = [t for t in _W.findall((text or '').lower())]
    return [(toks[i], toks[i+1]) for i in range(len(toks)-1)]

def _bigram_freq_product(w1, w2):
    f1 = word_frequency(w1, 'en') or 1e-10
    f2 = word_frequency(w2, 'en') or 1e-10
    return f1 * f2

def formulaic_sequence_penalty(text, anchor):
    bigs = _bigrams(text)
    if not bigs:
        return 0.5
    probs = [_bigram_freq_product(w1, w2) for w1, w2 in bigs]
    mean_prob = np.mean(probs)
    score = 1.0 / (1.0 + 1e8 * mean_prob)
    return max(0.0, min(1.0, score))

METRICS = {'formulaic_sequence_penalty': formulaic_sequence_penalty}

import re

_W = re.compile(r'[a-zA-Z\']+')
STOP = set('a an the and or but if then else of to in on at by for with from as is are was were be been being it its this that these those i you he she we they me him her us them my your his their our not no so do does did have has had will would can could should may might must about into over under out up down off than too very just also'.split())

def _content_toks(text):
    toks = [t for t in _W.findall((text or '').lower())]
    return [t for t in toks if t not in STOP and len(t) > 1]

def elaboration_expansion_ratio(text, anchor):
    text_toks = _content_toks(text)
    anchor_toks = _content_toks(anchor)
    if len(anchor_toks) == 0:
        return 0.5
    text_set = set(text_toks)
    anchor_set = set(anchor_toks)
    novel_toks = len(text_set - anchor_set)
    if len(text_set) == 0:
        return 0.5
    elaboration_ratio = novel_toks / len(text_set)
    length_increase = len(text_toks) / len(anchor_toks) if len(anchor_toks) > 0 else 1.0
    combined = elaboration_ratio * min(1.5, length_increase)
    score = min(1.0, combined)
    return max(0.0, score)

METRICS = {'elaboration_expansion_ratio': elaboration_expansion_ratio}

name: semantic_topic_coherence

Coherence is topical unity; high divergence from anchor topics breaks appropriateness. Inverted-U: some new concepts (elaboration) desirable, but excessive drift fails coherence. Targets uncovered coherence node; orthogonal to novelty/surprisal metrics; margin r likely < 0.6 vs incumbent semantic_distance (which measures TF-IDF on bigrams, not topical overlap quality).

import re

_W = re.compile(r'[a-zA-Z\']+')
STOP = set('a an the and or but if then else of to in on at by for with from as is are was were be been being it its this that these those i you he she we they me him her us them my your his their our not no so do does did have has had will would can could should may might must about into over under out up down off than too very just also'.split())

def _content_toks(text):
    toks = [t for t in _W.findall((text or '').lower())]
    return [t for t in toks if t not in STOP and len(t) > 1]

def semantic_topic_coherence(text, anchor):
    text_toks = _content_toks(text)
    anchor_toks = _content_toks(anchor)
    if not anchor_toks or not text_toks:
        return 0.5
    text_set = set(text_toks)
    anchor_set = set(anchor_toks)
    overlap = len(text_set & anchor_set)
    union_size = len(text_set | anchor_set)
    if union_size == 0:
        return 0.5
    jaccard = overlap / union_size
    ideal_overlap = 0.45
    deviation = abs(jaccard - ideal_overlap)
    score = 1.0 - 1.8 * deviation
    return max(0.0, min(1.0, score))

METRICS = {'semantic_topic_coherence': semantic_topic_coherence}
